correctness.rationale: The Debarre--Manivel coefficient formula specializes exactly to the stated plane count. For even d a single linear factor kills the top Chern polynomial modulo 2. For odd d, composition parities give Q_d=(xyz)^A(x+y+z)^(3q) modulo 2 with n-A=q+2. The Vandermonde coefficient simplifies to 2(3q)!/(q!(q+1)!(q+2)!). Legendre valuation summands are nonnegative from modulus 4 onward and at least one is positive for every q>=3, while q=1,2 give 1 and 5. Exact coefficient replay agrees with the displayed counts and sample even cases.

value.rationale: Finite Fano schemes are canonical enumerative objects. The theorem gives a complete parity phase law for every critical hypersurface plane problem, not a finite slice, and sharply shows that the all-odd phenomenon known for finite line counts breaks at r=2. The two exceptional degrees also yield immediate real-existence certificates on the transverse real locus.
